battle.name: 唐平安史之亂
battle.brief: 天寶十四載七月，安祿山以范陽三鎮節度使起兵，號蕃漢兵十五萬，半年破洛陽、陷長安；至德二載官軍收復兩京，廣德元年史朝義自盡，戰事凡八年。卡面秦弩雖是戰國以來的老兵器，唐軍卻把弩手編入府兵步軍，潼關、睢陽、太原諸役皆大量使用：守城以弩壓制雲梯與撞車，攻城則用弩先清城頭，再登梯肉搏。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 安史之亂是兩個以唐朝為名義的陣營之間打了八年的戰爭。叛方是安祿山在范陽、平盧、河東三鎮拼湊起來的蕃漢聯軍：骨幹是奚、契丹、同羅的騎兵，雜以羅契、室韋等部眾與漢人降卒，號稱十五萬眾，實際數字遠少於此；河北道原有的州縣官吏多數留任，糧秣靠范陽至漁陽的倉廩與河北的鹽榷、屯田接濟。反方是唐廷臨時拼成的勤王軍：朔方節度使郭子儀的北方精兵、靈州與河東的募兵、河南道與江淮的團練民兵，再加上關中禁軍，來源分兩套，一套是京師宿衛與北衙禁軍，一套是戰起後在河南、山東、河北就地招募的團練與義軍。指揮上，叛方由安祿山一人獨攬，後分給安慶緒、史思明；官方則由宰相、節度使、觀軍容使與宦官監軍層層分權，潼關與鄴城兩次慘敗，都與監軍挾制、主帥被迫出戰的調度有關。真正左右戰局的，是河北的兵源與江南的糧。
countriesEn: The An Lushan Rebellion was an eight-year war between two camps that both claimed to act in the name of the Tang. The rebel side was the mixed tribal and Chinese host that An Lushan pieced together out of the Fan-yang, Ping-lu and Hedong circuits: its backbone was cavalry drawn from the Xi, Khitan and Tongluo peoples, mixed with such groups as the Luochi and Shiwei and with Chinese soldiers who had surrendered. It was announced as a force of a hundred and fifty thousand, though the real number was far smaller. Most of the prefectural officials in Hebei circuit stayed at their posts, and grain was supplied from the granaries running from Fan-yang to Yuyang and from the salt monopoly and the garrison farms of Hebei. The Tang side was an improvised relief army: the northern troops of Shuo-fang jiedushi Guo Ziyi, recruited men from Ling-zhou and Hedong, the local militia and tuan-lian of Henan circuit and of the Yangtze and Huai valleys, together with the palace guards of the capital. It drew on two systems: the garrison and the northern imperial guard of the capital, and the tuan-lian and volunteer forces raised on the spot in Henan, Shandong and Hebei once the war had begun. On the command side the rebels obeyed a single man, An Lushan, who later shared that authority with An Qingxu and Shi Siming. The Tang side was split among chancellor, provincial military governor, commissioner of army inspection and eunuch supervisors, layer upon layer of divided authority. Both the disaster at Tong Pass and the rout before Ye were products of that division: a supervisor goading a commander into a battle he did not want to fight. What truly decided the war was the manpower of Hebei and the grain of the south.
people: 安祿山是發動者，本營州雜胡出身，靠討伐契丹、奚族起家，被玄宗一路提拔為范陽、平盧、河東三鎮節度使，掌兵二十萬，與宰相楊國忠交惡，遂以誅楊國忠為名，於天寶十四載七月自范陽舉兵，一路收城殺官，半年陷洛陽、克長安。史思明是安祿山的同族養子，起義前曾因罪被免官幽於范陽，兵變既起便重新起用，令其率兵西向，與安守忠、崔乾祐等分道並進，後弒安祿山自立，再敗於唐軍。官軍一方的主角是郭子儀與李光弼：郭子儀以朔方、河中之兵屢救兩京，李光弼以精騎破史思明於嘉山，又曾以七百精騎夜襲井陘、斬首千餘級，是唐軍少數乾淨利落的戰例。前期封常清、高仙芝退保潼關，哥舒翰奉命據關，卻因監軍邊令誠挾逼而被迫出關，靈寶一戰幾乎全軍覆沒。睢陽守將張巡、許遠以不足七千之眾當尹子奇十三萬大軍十月，張巡、許遠、南霽雲最終力戰而死；河北方面，顏杲卿在常山起兵被擒後遭肢解，顏真卿在平原聚眾，連絡河北十七州郡，募得義勇數萬，成為唐廷在河北唯一成建制的援軍。
peopleEn: An Lushan was the man who set the war off. A man of mixed Chuo-hu stock from Yingzhou, he rose on his record against the Khitan and the Xi, and the emperor Xuanzong promoted him step by step until he held three circuits at once, Fan-yang, Ping-lu and Hedong, with more than two hundred thousand men under him. He fell out with the chancellor Yang Guozhong, and in the seventh month of the fourteenth year of Tianbao he took up the cause of punishing Yang Guozhong and marched out of Fan-yang. Every city he took, he took by killing the officials. Within half a year Luoyang was lost and Chang'an fell. Shi Siming was his foster brother of the same tribe; before the rising he had been stripped of his post and confined at Fan-yang for an offence, and once the revolt was under way An Lushan brought him back into use and sent him west with a separate force, alongside An Shouchong and Cui Qianyou. Shi Siming later killed An Lushan, made himself king, and was in turn defeated by the Tang. On the Tang side the central figures were Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi: Guo Ziyi repeatedly rescued the two capitals with the troops of Shuo-fang and He-zhong, and Li Guangbi broke Shi Siming at Jiashan and once fell on Jingxing at night with seven hundred picked cavalry, taking more than a thousand heads, one of the few clean, sharp successes of the Tang army. Early on Feng Changqing and Gao Xianzhi fell back to Tong Pass, where the commander Geshu Han was nagged by the eunuch supervisor Bian Lingcheng into leaving the pass, and the army was annihilated almost completely at Lingbao. At Suiyang the garrison commanders Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan held out against Yin Ziqi's host of a hundred and thirty thousand with fewer than seven thousand men for ten months, and Zhang Xun, Xu Yuan and Nan Jiyun all died fighting. In Hebei, Yan Gaoqing raised troops at Changshan, was taken, and was dismembered; Yan Zhenqing gathered men at Pingyuan, reached seventeen prefectures of Hebei, and raised tens of thousands of volunteers, the only force in Hebei that the court could count on in formed units.
kits: 卡面這件秦弩是漢地最老的重步兵器械之一：戰國秦墓出土的銅弩機與機括已是成熟之作，漢代承襲不廢，唐代亦列入軍器簿，與弓、矛、刀、鎬、鑿同列。它不是奇兵，而是一整套制式裝備：木弩臂安上銅機括，箭的尾羽插入機括的箭槽，上弦之後扣住待發，射手不必像拉弓那樣把力氣留在弦上，可以據機瞄準，把全副力氣留給扣機的一瞬。制度上，唐的府兵步軍裏設有弩手、彊弩手、馬弩手等專職，彊弩以大張力配長矢，據唐代兵制記載，弓的有效射程約一百二十步，弩約二百步，正好用來在城頭或陣前壓住雲梯兵與攻城撞車。安史之亂中它是守軍的核心火力：睢陽城頭的弓弩手居高射擊，把逼近的雲梯、撞車與攀城的人成批打散；唐軍攻城也靠弩先清城頭，再扛梯登城。反方同樣大量使用弓弩，蕃漢兵齊射時密度極高，奚、契丹騎兵配強弓，便在野戰中與唐軍步騎爭射程。城防上，弩手與拒馬、長鉤、叉、撞竿並用，構成唐軍對付雲梯、飛梯、撞車的標準配備。
kitsEn: The Chinese crossbow on the card is among the oldest heavy infantry weapons of the Chinese lands: bronze trigger mechanisms and lock plates excavated from Qin tombs of the Warring States are already finished work, the Han inherited the device without letting it lapse, and the Tang entered it in the military equipment registers alongside the bow, the spear, the sword, the pick and the chisel. It is no exotic weapon but a complete standard system: a wooden bow arm fitted with a bronze lock, the fletching of the bolt dropped into the groove of the lock, the string drawn and caught, and the archer no longer obliged to hold the tension in his arms as he does with a bow. He sights along the lock and keeps his whole strength for the instant of the trigger. Institutionally the Tang foot soldiers contained specialised bodies of crossbowmen, strong crossbowmen and mounted crossbowmen; the strong crossbow paired a high tension with a long bolt, and Tang records of military administration give the effective range of the bow at about a hundred and twenty paces against about two hundred for the crossbow, exactly what was needed to pin ladder carriers and battering rams below a wall. In this war the crossbow was the core of the defending fire: the archers and crossbowmen on the walls of Suiyang shot down the ladders, the rams and the men climbing them in batches, and the Tang used crossbows to clear the wall before the scaling parties went up. The rebels used them just as heavily; the volley density of the mixed tribal and Chinese host was high, and Xi and Khitan cavalry carrying powerful bows competed with the Tang foot and horse in the open field, where range was the argument. On the defensive side crossbowmen worked together with cheval-de-frise, long hooks, forks and pole-axes, the standard answer of a Tang garrison to ladders, flying ladders and battering rams.
tactics: 叛軍的戰術是速戰與多路平推。安祿山分兵數路：自領主力自范陽南下取魏州、洛陽；令史思明等略河北，斷太行以絕河北道的糧道；另遣別將西趨太原、蒲坂，威脅關中。洛陽一戰，叛軍以精兵猛攻，掃清守軍的攻城器械，一時而拔，隨即西進長安。守方的打法則圍繞城壘、河流與險隘展開，唐軍不願在野地與叛軍競騎射，而是據城而守，以弩砲與弓弩封住接近路徑，再以騎兵奇襲與糧道打斷作反擊。睢陽是典範：張巡以六千八百人守孤城，把城頭分作三面，弓弩手輪番替換，晝夜射擊，敵人接近即被壓回去；敵造木鵰、撞車、雲梯，張巡作木鵰對之，縛蒿為人衣以甲胄、夜持仗城下以惑敵，又掘地道出擊，並在城門內修拒馬。夜里則派敢死隊出城焚燒敵軍攻具、截斷糧車。太原之役靠騎兵奇襲解圍，李光弼以少量精騎夜襲井陘口即扭轉戰局。鄴城之役則是轉折：唐軍以六十餘萬眾圍安慶緒，圍城日久，糧道拉得太長，叛軍援兵一到，唐軍大潰，兩京再失。糧道長度與援軍到來的時機，決定了整場戰爭的走向。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the rebels were speed and a broad front. An Lushan split his force into several columns: he led the main body south from Fan-yang to take Weizhou and Luoyang; he left Shi Siming and others to work through Hebei and cut the supply route of the northern circuit over the Taihang range; and he sent other commanders west toward Taiyuan and Puban to threaten Guanzhong. Luoyang fell quickly: the rebels drove in with picked troops, swept away the defenders' siege equipment and took the city in a single rush, then pressed on west to Chang'an. The Tang side fought around walls, rivers and difficult ground. It did not choose to trade mounted archery with the rebels in the open; it stood behind fortifications, sealed the approaches with crossbows and artillery, and answered with cavalry strikes and with cutting the enemy's supply line. Suiyang is the model. Zhang Xun held an isolated city with six thousand eight hundred men, divided the wall into three sectors, rotated the crossbowmen so that the firing never stopped, and shot day and night so that every approach was swept back. Against the rebels' wooden raptors, battering rams and ladders he built wooden raptors of his own, tied bundles of reeds into figures of men in armour, carried them down to the wall at night to confuse the enemy, dug tunnels for sorties, and set cheval-de-frise inside the gates. At night parties of forlorn hope went out of the city to burn the enemy's siege gear and cut its baggage train. At Taiyuan the battle was broken by a cavalry surprise, when Li Guangbi fell on Jingxing with a handful of picked men and turned the situation. The siege of Ye was the turning point of the whole war: the Tang committed more than six hundred thousand men around An Qingxu, the siege dragged on, the supply line grew too long, and when the rebel relieving force arrived the Tang army collapsed and the two capitals were lost again. The length of the supply line and the timing of the relieving army decided the war.
data: 可核對的數字集中在兵員與戶口兩頭。安祿山起兵時自將蕃漢兵十五萬眾，號稱二十萬；哥舒翰出關時所部官軍約二十萬，靈寶一戰死傷略盡，記載有八萬之數；攻睢陽的尹子奇率眾十三萬，張巡、許遠合兵不足七千，自756年十月守到757年三月，歷十個月；安慶緒被圍之際，唐軍集兵六十餘萬，史思明以十三萬眾自魏州南下解圍，唐軍遂潰。戰前天寶十載，朝廷版籍有戶九百零六萬五千九百一十五、口五千二百九十萬七千；到廣德元年，能登錄的只剩戶二百九十萬五千九百九十三、口一千六百九十二萬五千。制度數字也留在戰記裏：弓的有效射程約一百二十步，弩約二百步。睢陽陷落時四名大將同死，長安與洛陽先後於756年、759年兩度淪陷，763年史朝義在范陽附近自盡，戰事至此收場。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked sit at the two ends of the record: men and households. When An Lushan rose he led a mixed tribal and Chinese host of a hundred and fifty thousand, announced as two hundred thousand. When Geshu Han left Tong Pass he had about two hundred thousand Tang troops with him, and after Lingbao his army was wiped out, the record putting the dead at eighty thousand. Yin Ziqi brought a hundred and thirty thousand men against Suiyang, where Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan together had fewer than seven thousand; they held the city for ten months, from the tenth month of 756 to the third month of 757. When An Qingxu was besieged at Ye more than six hundred thousand Tang troops were assembled, and Shi Siming marched south from Weizhou with a hundred and thirty thousand to relieve him, and the Tang host broke. Before the war, in the tenth year of Tianbao, the household register of the empire listed 9,065,915 households and 52,907,000 persons; by the first year of Guangde the rolls that could still be compiled showed 2,905,993 households and 16,925,000 persons. Institutional figures survive in the war narrative as well: the effective range of the bow at about a hundred and twenty paces, of the crossbow at about two hundred. Four great commanders died together when Suiyang fell; Chang'an and Luoyang were each taken in turn, in 756 and in 759; and in 763 Shi Chaoyi killed himself near Fan-yang, which ended the fighting.
cause: 導火索很簡單：天寶年間玄宗寵信安祿山，把三鎮兵權、范陽與平盧的牧馬與榷利、嶽牧之權都交給他，卻又用楊國忠屢次逼迫；安祿山自恐見殺，於是提前動手。但安史之亂之所以成為一場八年的內戰，起因是結構性的。第一，天寶年間均田與租庸調已難維持，邊鎮卻在擴張：范陽、平盧、河東、河西、安西、北庭諸鎮各自募兵括戶，節度使的權力已大過朝廷，兵不屬國，糧自籌，安祿山一人兼三鎮、兵逾二十萬，正是這個制度的產物。第二，契丹、奚、同羅等部眾大量內附，蕃漢混編的私屬武力讓安祿山有了自己的軍隊。第三，宦官監軍與觀軍容使權力過重，朝廷對邊軍的調度屢屢失靈，潼關與鄴城兩役便是這樣崩盤的。第四，天寶末年連年災荒，漕運與轉運都已繃緊，755年關中、河南正在歉收，軍食不繼，兵一旦密集，饑餓立刻變成逃亡與崩潰。於是謀反有了兵、有了糧、有了號召，剩下的只是時機。
causeEn: The trigger was simple. Through the Tianbao years Xuanzong favoured An Lushan and handed him military authority over three circuits, over the horses and the trading monopolies of Fan-yang and Ping-lu, and over the power to appoint the governors of the marches; at the same time he let the chancellor Yang Guozhong press him again and again. An Lushan, fearing that he would be killed, struck first. Yet the rebellion became an eight-year civil war for structural reasons. First, the equal-field system and the rent, labour and silk levies of the Tianbao era could no longer be sustained, while the frontier commands went on expanding: Fan-yang, Ping-lu, Hedong, Hexi, Anxi and Beiting each recruited their own soldiers and registered their own households, and the power of the provincial military governors had grown past the power of the court. Troops no longer belonged to the state and grain was raised locally. An Lushan holding three circuits with more than two hundred thousand men was the product of exactly that arrangement. Second, large numbers of Khitan, Xi and Tongluo had submitted and been settled inside the frontier, and the mixed tribal and Chinese forces gave him a private army. Third, eunuch supervisors and commissioners of army inspection had grown too strong, and the court's direction of the frontier armies failed repeatedly; the collapses at Tong Pass and at Ye came about that way. Fourth, the disasters of the late Tianbao years had already put the transport system under strain, and in 755 the crops were failing in Guanzhong and in Henan; once troops were concentrated, hunger turned straight into desertion and collapse. The rebellion thus had men, grain and a cause; only the timing was missing, and that came on its own.
impact: 安史之亂結束的時候，唐廷的實力已不足以再收回河北。結果是三鎮割據：成德李寶臣、魏博田承嗣、盧龍李懷仙各據一方，中央要靠加官進爵與輸送軍糧去換取效忠，藩鎮的世襲化與地方化由此固定下來，中晚唐一百五十年的政治結構基本定型。經濟上，戶口由五千餘萬掉到一千七百萬上下，江南成為新的賦稅基地，兩稅法與江淮運漕隨之確立；北方大片土地荒廢，藩鎮所轄州縣自留軍賦，中央的財政與兵權再未統一。軍事上，平原與關中空虛，吐蕃在763年趁虛攻入長安，京師威信再受打擊；唐廷改以神策軍護衛宮禁，宦官因掌握禁軍而勢力坐大，內廷與外朝的衝突加深。對外，契丹、奚與吐蕃趁亂取得新的地位，回紇以援軍身份索取厚酬，唐廷的處境明顯惡化。最後，安史之亂重塑了唐詩：戰亂中的流離與苦難成了李白、杜甫、高適一輩人共同的素材，杜甫的「三吏」「三別」正是這八年留下的直接文本。
impactEn: When the An Lushan Rebellion ended, the Tang court no longer had the strength to take Hebei back. What it had instead was three autonomous commands: Li Baochen in Chengde, Tian Chengsi in Weibo and Li Huaixian in Lulong, each holding his own territory, the court buying their loyalty with titles and with shipments of grain. From that moment the hereditary and territorial character of the military governors was fixed, and the political structure of the middle and late Tang was settled for a hundred and fifty years. Economically, the population fell from over fifty million to something near seventeen million, the Yangtze and Huai valleys became the new fiscal base, and the two-tax system and the southern grain transport to the north were established in consequence. Vast tracts of the north lay fallow; the prefectures under the governors kept their own military revenues, and the unity of the court's finances and armies was never restored. Militarily, the plain and Guanzhong lay hollow, and in 763 the Tibetans took advantage of the opening to march into Chang'an, a further blow to the capital's prestige. The court made the palace guard the Shence Army, the eunuchs grew strong as the holders of the imperial guard, and the conflict between the inner court and the ministers deepened. Abroad, the Khitan, the Xi and the Tibetans gained new standing out of the disturbance, and the Uighurs demanded a heavy price for their help. And the war reshaped Tang poetry: the displacement and the suffering of the years became the shared material of Li Bai, Du Fu and Gao Shi, and Du Fu's Ballads of the Three Offices and Three Partings are the direct textual legacy of those eight years.
result: 結局分兩步。第一步是757年的反攻收復：廣平王李俶與郭子儀等率軍進至河陽，繞出叛軍之後，兩京先後光復，安慶緒退保鄴城，河北人心歸唐。第二步是消耗：唐軍圍鄴城日久，糧道拉長，759年史思明率援兵十三萬南下，唐軍六十餘萬眾在城下崩潰，兩京再失，長安陷落，形勢反而更壞。往後數年，史思明據河北與洛陽與唐軍拉鋸，763年被其子史朝義所殺；史朝義走投無路，在范陽附近自盡，部將奚可義等隨即赴唐請降。八年的戰爭至此結束，但勝利的形式是虛的：叛軍的首領死了，叛軍所據的河北基地卻變成了三鎮的藩鎮，朝廷既收不回兵權，也再沒有能力恢復戰前的版圖。唐廷只能把都城的安全寄托在神策軍與各鎮的效忠上，這正是中晚唐的開端。
resultEn: The ending came in two stages. The first was the counteroffensive of 757. The Prince of Guangping Li Chu, Guo Ziyi and the others drove the army to Heyang, came round behind the rebels and recovered the two capitals in turn; An Qingxu withdrew to Ye and the people of Hebei turned back to the Tang. The second stage was exhaustion. The siege of Ye dragged on, the supply line stretched, and in 759 Shi Siming marched south with a hundred and thirty thousand men to relieve An Qingxu. The Tang host of more than six hundred thousand broke before the city; the two capitals were lost again, Chang'an fell, and the situation grew worse. For several years afterwards Shi Siming held Hebei and Luoyang and fought the Tang to a standstill, until in 763 his own son Shi Chaoyi killed him. Left with no way out, Shi Chaoyi killed himself near Fan-yang, and his commanders, Xi Keyi among them, came to the Tang to surrender. There the eight years of war ended. But the victory was empty in its form: the leaders of the rebellion were dead, and the base the rebellion had held in Hebei had turned into the territories of three governors, while the court could neither take back the soldiers' loyalty nor restore the map of the years before the war. The Tang had no choice but to entrust the safety of the capital to the Shence Army and to the loyalty of the frontier commands, and that is where the middle and late Tang begins.
